title: Fixed Blunt Studded Roller and Offset Fork Grip
description: One newly authored complete fixed pastry-docker-style hand-tool exterior. A full broad cylindrical roller has six rows of twelve complete short blunt radial studs, each seated into the roller body with a finite capped outer tip. A whole transverse axle spans both ends inside one continuous U-shaped supporting fork. A separate whole down-bent neck joins the fork crossbar into a long contoured handle, whose lower facet and the downward stud tips share the ground datum. Roller, all studs, fork, axle, neck and grip form one whole original model, not seventy-two stud assets. All numerical geometry newly authored; no paint sleeve, engraving roulette, rolling pin or imported tooth reused. The long studded barrel and two-sided fork differ from the tiny integral diamond-grooved roulette on a single bent neck and the smooth paint sleeve on an offset one-sided shank. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Empty static bakery art only: blunt finite stud tips, no food, perforating/docking performance, rotation, bearing clearance, applied force, hygiene, food-contact suitability, hand fit, load, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
